definitions.explanation: Colorful varieties of carp bred for decorative purposes, kept in garden ponds and displayed in competitions. Originally developed in Niigata Prefecture, they are now admired worldwide.

examples.japanese: {池|いけ}に{錦鯉|にしきごい}が{泳|およ}いでいる。
examples.english: Koi are swimming in the pond.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}の{趣味|しゅみ}は{錦鯉|にしきごい}の{飼育|しいく}だ。
examples.english: My grandfather's hobby is raising koi.

examples.japanese: {品評会|ひんぴょうかい}で{優勝|ゆうしょう}した{錦鯉|にしきごい}は{数千万円|すうせんまんえん}の{値|ね}がつくこともある。
examples.english: A koi that wins at a show can be worth tens of millions of yen.

notes:
Compound of {錦|にしき} (brocade, referring to the colorful patterns) + {鯉|こい} (carp). The voiced form ごい is due to rendaku.

Koi breeding originated in {新潟県|にいがたけん} during the Edo period. Major varieties include {紅白|こうはく} (red and white), {大正三色|たいしょうさんしょく} (red, white, and black), and {昭和三色|しょうわさんしょく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {錦鯉|にしきごい}を{飼|か}う (to keep koi)
- {錦鯉|にしきごい}の{品評会|ひんぴょうかい} (koi show/competition)
- {錦鯉|にしきごい}の{養殖|ようしょく} (koi farming)
